messages.author: 10a1608939e8feba
messages.subject: physical distances
parts:
Hello- is there a way to show physical distances on the X axis of a 1D
QTL map instead of genetic distances?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] physical distances
parts:
You can use replacemap() to replace the map in scanone output with the physical map; this will use interpolation to assign physical positions to the "pseudomarker" locations.

Here's an example, using the 'hyper' data set. These aren't physical positions, but pretend that the original map of the markers was a physical map.

data(hyper)
pmap <- pull.map(hyper) # not really physical map, but pretend

gmap <- est.map(hyper, err=0.01)
gmap <- shiftmap(gmap) # shift so each chr starts at 0 cM

hyper <- replacemap(hyper, gmap)

hyper <- calc.genoprob(hyper, step=1, err=0.01)
out <- scanone(hyper)

# replace with original map, interpolating pseudomarker positions
out.pmap <- replacemap(out, pmap)

par(mfrow=c(2,1))
plot(out, chr=c(1,4), main="Estimated map")
plot(out.pmap, chr=c(1,4), main="Original map")

karl
